fact: The Ministry of Education's electronic staff census found 570 employees sharing the same national identity card number, among other duplicate numbers, and the August 2023 verification campaign set out to correct them in a payroll file with about 3,000 suspected fictitious employees.
title: Recensement du personnel du Ministère de l'Education Nationale et de la Recherche Scientifique
publisher: Ministère de l'Education Nationale et de la Recherche Scientifique
